title: Frosted Glass Blur, Inset Spacing & Acronym Cleanup (v0.4.9)
message: Signature low-latency frosted blur rendering, dynamic status bar header inset clearing, section card avatar cleanup, and PDF thumbnail rendering fix.
changelog:
• Frosted Glass Blur: Restored signature 12x hardware downsampled frosted acrylic blur on all top header navigation bars without background masking.
• Dynamic Status-Bar Insets: Synchronously added top insets to scroll containers so header bars never overlap content titles (e.g. 'MY ACTIVE CLASSES').
• Section Cleanups: Removed redundant monogram acronyms ('10C') from class cards.
• PDF Thumbnails: Removed tint overlay to render clean crisp cover thumbnails in library lists.
